# 原生技能专属机制历史设计库存

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-condition-coverage.py -->

全部1,095个原生定义的历史设计库存，保留G00–G21原始标签、原生标记、中英文机制描述及当时的缺口。条目内的“未实现”是原始库存状态，不能用来统计当前游戏缺失功能或缺少条件的英雄数。最新取舍与实现见 [v19 简化特殊机制与英雄池](RUNTIME_FIXES_V19.md)：固定装置及吞噬/劝化使用普通条件；抓树自动处理；投掷新增抓取条件；残焰/游魂支持目的地；召唤物采用固定行为。土猫、卡尔、拉比克、凯暂不进入游戏池。普通通用模式不表示全部原生专属机制已重现；无描述条目保留缺失，不猜造语义。

native vector基础已实现：最近合法锚点及固定延长150的原生双命令；普通CHANNELLED启动与busy保护已实现。它们不实现G20专属几何/双目标选择，也不实现G10定时释放/提前取消。逐ID基础模式另列，原始缺口标签保留作设计库存，不能理解为基础原生命令也全部缺失。游戏内执行实测0。

## 原始缺口标签

| 标签 | 机制 | 待具备能力（设计范围） |
|---|---|---|
| G00 | 完整合法目标 | 先筛射程/技能合法性再排序？免疫、不可选、林肯等应避开还是允许破盾？敌友两用技能如何选择意图？ |
| G01 | 目标低血、治疗/护盾/救援 | HP%或绝对缺血？最低有效治疗量？是否排除自身？多人濒危如何排序？ |
| G02 | 范围人数与范围收益 | 以施法者、目标点还是线段为中心？N人中英雄/召唤物权重？允许单杀时忽略人数吗？ |
| G03 | 控制、打断、驱散、免疫 | 识别哪些控制？剩余≤X秒再接控？能否赶上前摇/引导？驱散优先级和强弱驱散如何区分？ |
| G04 | 斩杀与伤害收益 | 预计结算后可击杀？是否计算魔抗/护盾/治疗/无敌？避免多英雄同时浪费斩杀如何预留目标？ |
| G05 | 自动施法、开关、持续耗蓝 | 分别设计“开启”和“关闭”；蓝量上下阈值是否不同以防抖？攻击目标切换时如何处理？ |
| G06 | 连招、先后顺序和共享状态 | “A已成功施放/命中”与“发出A命令”区分；B等多久？目标死亡/技能失败如何中止或降级？ |
| G07 | 位移方向、落点和运动预判 | 进攻、撤退、躲技能三种意图？落点安全距离？墙/悬崖/敌群检测？线技能按当前位置还是预测位置？ |
| G08 | 召唤物、分身、支配、多单位 | 数量/寿命/血量门槛？是否共享规则？各单位分工？本体死亡和切换控制后的规则归属？ |
| G09 | 标记、层数、剩余持续时间 | 是否要求自己施加的标记？层数≥N、剩余≤X？多个目标分别追踪？刷新与引爆条件？ |
| G10 | 持续施法、蓄力与中止 | 普通引导启动和busy保护已实现；定时释放、提前取消、危险打断和专属阶段程序未实现。 |
| G11 | 全图、视野、传送和远距目标 | 必须可见还是允许已知位置？全图友军可否选？传送后安全性及非战斗目标如何处理？ |
| G12 | 充能及特殊资源 | 至少保留几层充能？生命/魔法/能量/魂数储备？充能恢复和普通冷却分别展示？ |
| G13 | 树、建筑、尸体、装置等对象 | 对象类型、距离、可用性与归属；没有合法对象时是否改选别的动作？ |
| G14 | 纯被动观察（可包含先天） | 哪些被动层数、内置冷却、复活状态应向其他规则开放？纯被动不设计“自动施放”；主动型先天仍按主动技能分类 |
| G15 | 神杖/魔晶/命石/形态/额外技能 | 升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？ |
| G16 | 友军误伤、交换、献血等风险 | 生命下限、禁止牺牲名单、换位/拉扯允许对象；收益不确定时默认不用还是冒险？ |
| G17 | 敌友两用、自施放、替代施放 | 治疗友军与伤害敌军各设一条规则？Alt/自施放意图是否独立动作？ |
| G18 | 再次释放、返回、终止、子技能 | 子技能何时可用？首次目标如何继承？取消/返回与进攻再释放的优先级？ |
| G19 | 普攻附魔和攻击时机 | 手动法球还是自动施法？攻击前摇/攻击间隔、射程、目标类型及耗蓝预算如何约束？ |
| G20 | 矢量/双点/双目标 | native vector基础已实现；专属起点/终点/朝向、双目标几何及落点程序未实现。 |
| G21 | 英雄特有机制 | Invoker配球/调用、Rubick偷技能后规则、Morph技能复制、Kez双武器、Largo节奏/曲目等如何接入通用规则？ |

## `antimage_mana_break` — 法力损毁 / Mana Break

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G14, G15, G19；机制标签：被动观察、攻击附魔

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_PASSIVE`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：每次攻击损毁目标魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。

English mechanism: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.

缺失能力：哪些被动层数、内置冷却、复活状态应向其他规则开放？纯被动不设计“自动施放”；主动型先天仍按主动技能分类；升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？；手动法球还是自动施法？攻击前摇/攻击间隔、射程、目标类型及耗蓝预算如何约束？

## `antimage_counterspell` — 法术反制 / Counterspell

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

## `antimage_persectur` — 绝人之路 / Persecutor

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G03, G14；机制标签：控制／驱散、被动观察

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_PASSIVE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_INNATE_UI | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：攻击会根据敌人缺失的魔法值造成减速。%mana_threshold%%%魔法时造成最低减速，0%%魔法时造成最高减速。敌人高于%mana_threshold%%%魔法时没有效果。

English mechanism: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.

缺失能力：哪些被动层数、内置冷却、复活状态应向其他规则开放？纯被动不设计“自动施放”；主动型先天仍按主动技能分类

## `antimage_mana_void` — 法力虚空 / Mana Void

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G02, G03；机制标签：范围收益、控制／驱散

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AOE`; team: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY`; types: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO | DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC`; target flags: ``.

中文机制：根据目标损失的魔法值，对目标和其周围的敌人造成伤害。所有受到伤害的单位都会被短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

English mechanism: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.

缺失能力：没有额外专属状态机复核结论；原始标签对应的设计能力未逐项实现或验收。

## `antimage_counterspell_ally` — 友军法术反制 / Counterspell Ally

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G08, G15；机制标签：多单位

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMMEDIATE`; team: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY`; types: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO`; target flags: ``.

中文机制：在附近一个友军目标周围制造一个反魔法外壳，抵挡并反弹所有指向性技能。法术反制或友军法术反制抵挡技能后，都会在敌人身旁产生一个敌法师的幻象。

English mechanism: Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.

缺失能力：数量/寿命/血量门槛？是否共享规则？各单位分工？本体死亡和切换控制后的规则归属？；升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？

## `axe_culling_blade` — 淘汰之刃 / Culling Blade

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G02, G04, G09；机制标签：范围收益、斩杀／伤害预计、标记／层数／剩余

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET`; team: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY`; types: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO | DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC`; target flags: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES`.

中文机制：斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。\n\n每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。

English mechanism: Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.\n\nAxe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

缺失能力：是否要求自己施加的标记？层数≥N、剩余≤X？多个目标分别追踪？刷新与引爆条件？

## `mirana_arrow` — 月神之箭 / Sacred Arrow

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

中文机制：射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。目标距离越远，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。

English mechanism: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.

## `morphling_adaptive_strike_agi` — 变体打击 / Adaptive Strike

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G03, G07；机制标签：控制／驱散、方向／位移落点

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET`; team: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY`; types: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO | DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC`; target flags: ``.

中文机制：用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。\n\n击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

English mechanism: Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.\n\nKnockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.

缺失能力：进攻、撤退、躲技能三种意图？落点安全距离？墙/悬崖/敌群检测？线技能按当前位置还是预测位置？

## `nevermore_frenzy` — 灵魂盛宴 / Feast of Souls

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G02, G09, G12, G15；机制标签：范围收益、标记／层数／剩余、充能／资源

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMMEDIATE`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续%duration%秒。在持续时间内，每%soul_collection_interval%秒他从%soul_collection_radius%范围内的%soul_collection_per_interval%个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留%linger_duration%秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。\n\n从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。

English mechanism: Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.\n\n Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

缺失能力：是否要求自己施加的标记？层数≥N、剩余≤X？多个目标分别追踪？刷新与引爆条件？；至少保留几层充能？生命/魔法/能量/魂数储备？充能恢复和普通冷却分别展示？；升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？

English mechanism: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. <br><br> Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.

Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

English mechanism: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. **专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

English mechanism: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

## `rattletrap_power_cogs` — 能量齿轮 / Power Cogs

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：；机制标签：通用主动机制

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且%mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。<br><br>敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出%projectile_distance%距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。

English mechanism: Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned.<br><br> Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.

缺失能力：没有额外专属状态机复核结论；原始标签对应的设计能力未逐项实现或验收。

## `life_stealer_infest` — 感染 / Infest

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

原始标签：G01, G02, G03, G15；机制标签：治疗／救援、范围收益、控制／驱散

中文机制：噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散

English mechanism: Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

缺失能力：技能专属状态、对象、资源、方向、目的地或阶段调度契约；仅通用条件不实现该机制。；升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？

中文机制：育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多%count%个触碰已有蛛网的<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。

English mechanism: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.

## `chen_zealot` — 狂热者 / Zealot

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

中文机制：陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈复活%zealot_respawn_time%秒后在陈身边复活。<br><br>狂热者技能可以主动使用，在%teleport_delay%秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。

English mechanism: Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy.  The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage.  The Zealot respawns next to Chen after %zealot_respawn_time%s.<br><br>Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a %teleport_delay% second delay.  If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.

缺失能力：进攻、撤退、躲技能三种意图？落点安全距离？墙/悬崖/敌群检测？线技能按当前位置还是预测位置？；生命下限、禁止牺牲名单、换位/拉扯允许对象；收益不确定时默认不用还是冒险？；技能专属状态、对象、资源、方向、目的地或阶段调度契约；仅通用条件不实现该机制。；升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？

历史复核（当前未实现）：Corrected English active teleports a controlled unit to Chen after a delay. With no enemy within 600 of Chen, retrieve an owned wounded creep <=40% HP at least 600 away. Enemy damage can cancel; no safe incoming-projectile guarantee. Native target legality remains required.

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

原始标签：G01, G02, G04, G07, G09, G11, G15, G18；机制标签：治疗／救援、范围收益、斩杀／伤害预计、方向／位移落点、标记／层数／剩余、全图／视野、再释放／子技能

If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.

## `alchemist_unstable_concoction` — 不稳定化合物 / Unstable Concoction

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

原始标签：G02, G03, G10, G16, G18；机制标签：范围收益、控制／驱散、引导／蓄力、风险／交换、再释放／子技能

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMMEDIATE`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。调制的时间越久，伤害越大，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间也越长。炼金术士在调制期间获得移动速度加成。调制%brew_time%秒后达到最大伤害量和最长<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间。然而，若%brew_explosion%秒后未扔出药剂，则会在炼金术士自己手中爆炸。

English mechanism: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.

缺失能力：普通引导原生启动及busy保护已实现；专属释放时机、最小引导、危险打断、目标离开时中止和阶段调度未实现。；生命下限、禁止牺牲名单、换位/拉扯允许对象；收益不确定时默认不用还是冒险？；子技能何时可用？首次目标如何继承？取消/返回与进攻再释放的优先级？；技能专属状态、对象、资源、方向、目的地或阶段调度契约；仅通用条件不实现该机制。

历史复核（当前未实现）：不稳定化合物开始后不及时投掷会自爆；近敌起手缺乏可靠后续目标及投掷时序，单独起手不计为实用模式。

## `shadow_demon_shadow_poison` — 暗影剧毒 / Shadow Poison

English mechanism: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

中文机制：敌方英雄获得%hits_required%层叠加效果后独行德鲁伊可以<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。<br><br>施放时，对区域内每个敌方英雄施加%hits_incremented_on_active%层叠加效果，对敌方非英雄单位施加%hits_required%层。独行德鲁伊的攻击还会被强化%lone_druid_buff_duration%秒，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加%lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip%层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。<br><br>升级这个技能也会升级熊灵的缠绕之爪技能。

English mechanism: Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.<br><br>When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.<br><br>Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.

## `meepo_divided_we_stand` — 分则能成 / Divided We Stand

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

中文机制：米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。<br><br>来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少%dps_penalty_pct%%%。<br><br>任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。

English mechanism: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. <br><br>Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.<br><br>If any Meepo dies, they all die.

## `rubick_curiosity` — 奇心 / Curiosity

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

原始标签：G02, G09, G14；机制标签：范围收益、标记／层数／剩余、被动观察

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_PASSIVE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_FORCE_NO_INNATE_UI | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：拉比克现在每级获得%curiosity_per_level%层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供%curiosity_attack_damage%点基础攻击力，%curiosity_modifier_amp%%%增益/减益持续时间，和%curiosity_aoe_bonus%<font color='#c450e5'>作用范围</font>加成。<br><br>如果拉比克看到%charge_radius%范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得%curiosity_per_spell_cast%层奇心，持续%curiosity_duration%秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后%grace_period%秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得%curiosity_per_kill%层奇心。

English mechanism: Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus. <br><br>If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds.  If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

缺失能力：是否要求自己施加的标记？层数≥N、剩余≤X？多个目标分别追踪？刷新与引爆条件？；技能专属状态、对象、资源、方向、目的地或阶段调度契约；仅通用条件不实现该机制。；哪些被动层数、内置冷却、复活状态应向其他规则开放？纯被动不设计“自动施放”；主动型先天仍按主动技能分类

原始标签：G07, G12, G15, G17；机制标签：方向／位移落点、充能／资源、敌友两用／替代施放

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DONT_RESUME_ATTACK | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_ALT_CASTABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES`; team: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY`; types: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_CUSTOM`; target flags: `DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_INVULNERABLE`.

中文机制：短暂延迟后，将友方英雄目标传送到你的位置。如果在此期间，友方英雄目标受到来自玩家的伤害，召回将被打断。施放时会对光之守卫和传送目标同时施加移动速度加成，并且传送目标会被施加查克拉魔法。<br><br>如果设为<font color=\"#FF0000\">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），会把光之守卫传送至目标友军。<br><br>技能等级随着灵魂形态的等级提升。

English mechanism: After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location.  If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.<br><br> If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead. <br><br> Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.

历史复核（当前未实现）：召回的查克拉恢复模式：自身附近无敌人时召回魔法≤35%的其他友方英雄，抵达后获得查克拉魔法；不预测传送打断或安全性。

## `techies_land_mines` — 感应地雷 / Proximity Mines

English mechanism: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. ## `earth_spirit_stone_caller` — 残岩 / Stone Remnant

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

原始标签：G06, G09, G11, G12, G13, G15, G19；机制标签：连招顺序、标记／层数／剩余、全图／视野、充能／资源、特殊对象、攻击附魔

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。<br><br>每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得%attack_damage_per_stone%%%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得%attack_damage_per_stone_used%%%攻击力加成，持续%buff_duration%秒（无法叠加）。

English mechanism: Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.<br><br>Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

缺失能力：“A已成功施放/命中”与“发出A命令”区分；B等多久？目标死亡/技能失败如何中止或降级？；是否要求自己施加的标记？层数≥N、剩余≤X？多个目标分别追踪？刷新与引爆条件？；必须可见还是允许已知位置？全图友军可否选？传送后安全性及非战斗目标如何处理？；至少保留几层充能？生命/魔法/能量/魂数储备？充能恢复和普通冷却分别展示？；对象类型、距离、可用性与归属；没有合法对象时是否改选别的动作？；技能专属状态、对象、资源、方向、目的地或阶段调度契约；仅通用条件不实现该机制。；升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？；手动法球还是自动施法？攻击前摇/攻击间隔、射程、目标类型及耗蓝预算如何约束？

历史复核（当前未实现）：Manual pair required: configure this rule AND Boulder Smash smash_owned_stone separately. With a nearby enemy, ready Boulder Smash and no owned stone within 200, place a stone at self. This useful resource preparation does not prove a consumer rule is configured or schedule its execution.

## `earth_spirit_magnetize` — 磁化 / Magnetize

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 仅可采用独立通用模式（如有）；不含专属调度。

原始标签：G02, G09, G13；机制标签：范围收益、标记／层数／剩余、特殊对象

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：将附近小范围内的敌方单位磁化，使其短时间内受到伤害。被磁化的英雄单位将会引起附近残岩的爆炸，每次爆炸都将摧毁残岩并刷新残岩附近单位身上的磁化时间（若附近单位未被磁化则为其施加一个磁化效果）。该过程可重复数次。如果一个被磁化的英雄受到了地磁之握或巨石冲击的作用，那么所有被磁化的英雄都会受到同样效果。

English mechanism: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

缺失能力：是否要求自己施加的标记？层数≥N、剩余≤X？多个目标分别追踪？刷新与引爆条件？；对象类型、距离、可用性与归属；没有合法对象时是否改选别的动作？

中文机制：装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。<br><br>凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。<br><br>子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。

中文机制：朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。\n\n击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。\n\n驱散类型：弱驱散

English mechanism: Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.\n\nKilling or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

缺失能力：至少保留几层充能？生命/魔法/能量/魂数储备？充能恢复和普通冷却分别展示？；Invoker配球/调用、Rubick偷技能后规则、Morph技能复制、Kez双武器、Largo节奏/曲目等如何接入通用规则？；技能专属状态、对象、资源、方向、目的地或阶段调度契约；仅通用条件不实现该机制。

历史复核（当前未实现）：舔舐敌方单位造成伤害、驱散并拉回；额外神符模式无需自动化。

## `largo_croak_of_genius` — 灵呱一闪 / Croak of Genius

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

中文机制：朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来%damage_duration%秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。\n\n只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少%duration_reduction%秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。

English mechanism: Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.\n\nWhen an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.

## `largo_amphibian_rhapsody` — 两栖狂想曲 / Amphibian Rhapsody

**专属机制状态：未实现。** 专用动作排除全部预设。

原始标签：G05, G09, G15, G21；机制标签：开关／持续消耗、标记／层数／剩余、英雄专属状态机

Native flags: `DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_TOGGLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMMEDIATE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_INVISIBLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_CHANNEL | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_SILENCE`; team: ``; types: ``; target flags: ``.

中文机制：朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。\n\n每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。

English mechanism: Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.\n\nEvery time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.

缺失能力：是否要求自己施加的标记？层数≥N、剩余≤X？多个目标分别追踪？刷新与引爆条件？；Invoker配球/调用、Rubick偷技能后规则、Morph技能复制、Kez双武器、Largo节奏/曲目等如何接入通用规则？；技能专属状态、对象、资源、方向、目的地或阶段调度契约；仅通用条件不实现该机制。；升级后保留规则还是创建分支？同一技能目标/范围变化如何刷新？禁用的变体是否隐藏？

历史复核（当前未实现）：两栖狂想曲仅覆盖退出模式：附近无敌人时显式关闭以恢复攻击；三首歌曲需要节拍状态，仍不覆盖。
